_comment: Server (webhook) tools for the ElevenLabs agent. Replace https://YOUR-BACKEND with where `pnpm start` runs (it must be reachable over https, e.g. a tunnel while testing). conversation_id comes from the system dynamic variable, never from the model.

tools.name: unlock_account
tools.description: Unlock the verified caller's account. Only after Scute verified them.

tools.name: reset_password
tools.description: Reset the verified caller's password; the temporary one goes to their email. Needs a fresh verification (Scute will say so).

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Open a helpdesk ticket for the verified caller.

summary.description: One line: what they need help with
